caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display against a dark sky, with a diagonal power line crossing the frame and a tree silhouette at the lower edge. Several golden-white starburst clusters hang expanded across the upper frame, slowly dimming as a bright white flash and smoke bloom and recede at the bottom center. A magenta glow pulses inside one left cluster. Then an overexposed flash erupts from the lower left before fading. As the original bursts fade to scattered dots, short bright streaks rise from the bottom edge, climbing upward through the smoke. These ascending trails open into fan-shaped golden bursts near the top, accompanied by intermittent red glints and further white flashes that wash out the scene.
relations: Expanded starburst clusters slowly dim as their glowing particles cool and drift downward.
Smoke from the bright flash blooms and recedes, partially veiling the lower bursts.
Short bright trails rise from the bottom edge through smoke and open into fan-shaped golden bursts.
Overexposed flashes intermittently wash out the scene while the power line and tree silhouette stay fixed.
